flags.issue: Wording 'any Observation Date beginning September 28, 2026' read literally includes the Final Observation Date (12 levels); Example 2 also shows a $10.2275 'Settlement Amount' at final. Economically equivalent to maturity payout, but verify inclusion.
Barriers are stated as 'approximately 70%'; exact ratios differ slightly (e.g. 5,147.81/7,354.02 = 69.99997%). Used 70.
Tickers SPX/RTY/SX5E taken from the filing's defined short names ('SPX Index' etc.), not an explicit ticker field.
Dates subject to postponement; scheduled dates used as printed.

scope.reason: Worst-of autocallable contingent-coupon note on three equity indices (SPX, RTY, SX5E price-return); quarterly discrete autocall at 100%, non-memory coupon at 70%, European (final-date-only) 70% knock-in with 1:1 downside. Note: SX5E is a EUR index, no quanto adjustment in payoff.
